catalyst.name: Causality Quiver, Ticuu's Divination Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Triggering Sacred Flame explosions grants one stack of 'Causality Quiver' for 5.5 seconds. Marking enemies with Sacred Flame refreshes the buff. Maximum of 6 stacks.
Causality Quiver increases the impact damage of your arrows (not the explosion) at 1|2|3|4|5|6 stacks:
• PvE: 16%|31%|49%|67.5%|87%|87%
• PvP: 3.6%|11%|12%|16%|23%|23%

multiplier.note: percent to factor; the value of the 5th and 6th stack (the maximum), PvE

durationMs.note: seconds to milliseconds; marking the boss renews it

source.name: Item file ticuu-s-divination
source.quote: Causality Quiver increases the impact damage of your arrows (not the explosion)
source.note: Derived: the stacks come from explosions, which need kills (ADR 0015); the playstyle "pre-stacked" builds the 6 stacks before the phase (kill buffs only built up), the buff of 87 % is the 6-stack value
